d: Jharkhand vidhanasbha ke kal se shuru hone vale vistarit satr ke hangamedar rahne ke aasar hain. sadan men satta paksh aur vipaksh ke bich esaaaeeaar aur emaemdiaar ke muddon par tikhi bahas aur var-palatvar dekhne ko mil sakta hai. donon pakshon ne in muddon par apni-apni ranniti taiyar kar li hai. vahin, shri guru nanak dev ji ke prakash parv ke avsar par rajyabhar men shraddha aur ullas ka mahaul raha. gurudvaron men shraddhaluon ne mattha tekkar naman kiya aur aayojit shabad kirtan men khas aur aam logon ne hissa liya. is dauran guru vani se vatavran bhaktimay bana raha. vahin, dev…
